keyFindings.description: No `## Contract change census`. The PR removes the `envoy-dispatch backfill-embeddings` subcommand (exit 2 now), drops the `embeddings_backfill_progress` table, adds boot refusals (any DISPATCH_AZURE_* without DISPATCH_EMBEDDER=azure, the Azure shape refusals) and gcp:Dispatch input refusals, and changes the exported `embed` and `embedqueue` API (embed.New/Model/MaxBatchTexts gone, Embedder gains Identity/Limits, embedqueue.Backfill gone). Each needs its search, hits with dispositions, and rollout line. Reviewer's own searches: theorem-labs/agent-infra code search for backfill-embeddings, embeddings_backfill_progress and DISPATCH_AZURE returned 0 hits each; in-tree hits are docs, CHANGELOG, migration comments and main_test.go's negative case.

dead_model is added null for every existing dead row, and readmitForeignDead (coverage.go:162-173) and foreignRows (coverage.go:197-202) treat `dead_model is distinct from $identity` as foreign, so on a Bedrock deployment that sets nothing new every row dead before this release is re-admitted at the first proven pass and confirmed dead again (ERROR lines at canary.go:41 and queue.go, extra Bedrock calls). The spec's acceptance says Bedrock is unchanged for a deployment that sets nothing new. Every pre-0117 dead row was confirmed against us.cohere.embed-v4:0 (main.go at f2c17ded called embed.New with no WithModel), so 0117 should set dead_model = 'us.cohere.embed-v4:0' where dead; a switch to Azure still re-admits them once.
Cites coverage.go:70 and :72 for the comment and message rows of coverageSources; they are at coverage.go:65 and :67 (70-72 is items()' doc comment).
Comments still describe the scenario as a backfill's bulk traffic and a saturating backfill in progress; the backfill is gone (the coverage pass and the queue's drain are the bulk traffic now).

thermonuclear.deepReview: APPROVE at 953fc6fe: two Minor (legacy dead rows re-admitted on unchanged Bedrock, adopted here as Important because it contradicts a spec acceptance line; wrong line refs in check-body-embed-limit.sh) and hardening (coverage route hashes the whole corpus per request; Azure success body decoded unbounded, azure.go:217; key accessor grant on the shared principal; no token-cache reset on 401; 0117's pending_since update under the ALTER's lock).
thermonuclear.codeQuality: CHANGES at 953fc6fe: Important 1 (keep foreign vectors and mark rows pending instead of the proven/canary gate) and Important 2 (settle empty text at write time instead of in scanPending) judged by the reviewer as design alternatives, not defects: the gate is correct, tested and proven live, and dropping keeps the HNSW index free of foreign vectors as plan decision 7 wants; the empty-text settle is correct and tested. Minors 3-8 are structure and wording; the stale backfill wording is carried as a finding.

planEvidence: Plan review-evidence checklist (plan.md 'Review evidence') holds item by item: no Bedrock constant on the Azure path, the CAS guard and pending-row claim handling, coverageSources byte-for-byte against 0073-0077 and 0072/0117's hash, the report's definitions, the settings refusals, and select-0 censuses for 0117/0118 (a non-zero census refuses the deploy, so the plan's counting censuses would have been wrong).
ci: Required set (rulesets): lint, typecheck, test, pr-title; branch protection lists none. CI head 55eb49eb71c11bf1b4f5c05566a01a04204ffa78: all four completed success; compare to 953fc6fe touches only .legion/.
